castle.observedDefect: The source rejects only after two active-range misses, so one active range cannot reject an item.

authoringContract.activePair: A nonzero low endpoint enables one inclusive low-through-high range.
authoringContract.disabledPair: A zero low endpoint disables the pair; its retained high word is inert.
authoringContract.combination: An item is accepted when it belongs to any active range; no active ranges means unrestricted.
